meaning:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ch.29.12;
son of: Amasai (H6022J)
§ Mahath = "grasping"
1) a Kohathite Levite of the house of Korah
2) a Kohathite Levite in the reign of king Hezekiah

elsewhere.note: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
Then the Levites arose, Mahath, the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi…
